question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

She was bored because she didn't have any __work to does__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3 i.e.(work to do)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb form 'does' is incorrect in this context. The correct form is 'do', making the phrase 'work to do'.
